description: This Java class 'MultiMappedOutboundSignal' is part of the Eclipse Ditto project. It models outbound signals that are mapped from a single source signal, supporting serialization to JSON and handling multiple target signals. It implements the 'OutboundSignal.MultiMapped' interface and includes methods for equality, hashing, string representation, and retrieval of source, targets, and mapped signals.

classes.name: MultiMappedOutboundSignal
classes.description: A final class representing outbound signals mapped from one source signal, supporting JSON serialization, comparison, and retrieval of signal properties.

methods.name: MultiMappedOutboundSignal
methods.description: Constructor initializing the outbound signals and optional sender ActorRef.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare outbound signals and sender actor references.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to generate hash based on outbound signals and sender.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object, including outbound signals and sender.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns the source signal of the first mapped outbound signal.

methods.name: getTargets
methods.description: Returns the list of targets from the first mapped outbound signal.

methods.name: getMappedOutboundSignals
methods.description: Returns the list of all mapped outbound signals.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the sender ActorRef if present.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the first mapped outbound signal.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the object to a JsonObject, including mapped outbound signals and sender.
